name: Trefoil
description: Three lobes — the trefoil, worked as an outline so the light comes through it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 300; r: abs(cos(1.5t))^0.6; scale: 0.96; frame: 13; turn: 2); clip-path: @shape(points: 300; r: abs(cos(1.5t))^0.6; scale: 0.96; frame: 13; turn: 2); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
